svg.aria-label: How each question is run: Regulation Z from eCFR XML is parsed into 59 sections and 352 paragraphs. The chunked baselines (BM25, dense, hybrid) search 941 chunks and pass the top 5 chunks on; the vectorless navigator picks sections from the table of contents and then paragraphs from their outline, optionally using 363 index summaries written by Claude Haiku 5.5, and passes the top 3 paragraphs on. Claude Haiku 5.5 answers, Hit@k is scored on the gold paragraph and Claude Sonnet 5.5 grades the answer; records go to results/.

svg.text: All methods are scored on the same unit, the top-level paragraph. The vectorless index is the regulation's own structure.
